units.translation: Another example of this word is in Constant. Manass. Chron. 4317 πικροκαρπότερος κλάδος [a branch bearing more bitter fruit].
to accomplish the slaughter of men
a branch bearing more bitter fruit
in the sense of hostile or inimical

Buttmann conjectured in Lexil. vol. 1 p. 17 that the original meaning was sharp, piercing, as Homer said πικρὰ βέλεμνα [sharp arrows] and πικρὸς ὀϊστός [sharp arrow], and Sophocles πικρᾷ γλωχίνι [with sharp point] and πικροῦ κνώδοντος [of the sharp blade] (of a sword). Thence transferred to taste, as
Ὅταν δὲ τεύχη Ζεὺς ἀπ᾿ ὄμφακος [But when Zeus makes from the unripe grape]
Of a sharp, plaintive, querulous voice

Thus Hermannus corrected for ἴυζε καὶ βόα πικρότερ᾽ ἀχέων οἰζύος ὄνομ᾽ ἔχων [cry out and shout, having a name more bitter than the griefs of misery]. The word is most frequently used by the tragedians of persons and things causing sharper pain.
Ἥκουσ᾽ αἵδ᾽ ἐπὶ πρᾶγος [these have come upon the matter]
Πικρὸς δὲ χρημάτων κακὸς [and a bitter evil of wealth]
Πικρὰν δὲ παῖς ἐμὸς τιμωρίαν κλεινῶν [and my son, a bitter vengeance of the glorious]
thus Victor. for πικρῶν [of bitter things]
Πῶς οὐχὶ τἀνάλωμα γίγνεται [How is it not becoming the expenditure]
Τοὺς φιλτάτους γὰρ οἶδα νῷν ὄντας [for I know that they are dearest to us two]
Ἄθεον ἄνδρα καὶ τοκεῦσιν [a godless man and to his parents]
Κοίμα κελαινοῦ κύματος [lull of the dark wave]
lest the breath of the wave strike your mouth; for bitter and not through life are the vapors
a strain more bitter than misery
you do not relax anything in your troubles
you have met, maiden, a suitor for your marriage
But when Zeus makes from the unripe grape
cry out and shout, having a name more bitter than the griefs of misery
these have come upon the matter
and a bitter evil of wealth
and my son, a bitter vengeance of the glorious
How is it not becoming the expenditure
for I know that they are dearest to us two
a godless man and to his parents
Καί μου τὰ μὲν πραχθέντα πρὸς τοὺς ἐκτενεῖς φίλους [and the things done by me towards my zealous friends]
and the things done by me towards my zealous friends
Τοσῶνδε κρατῆρ᾽ ἐν δόμοις κακῶν ὅδε [such a mixing bowl of evils in the house this]
where I emended to περαίνων [accomplishing], of which the gloss was πιμπλάνων [filling], now corrupted in Min to πιμπλάντων [of those filling].]
Ὅ μὲν ἐν χερσὶν βόμβυκας ἔχων δακτυλόδικτον [the one holding in his hands the finger-pointed shuttle]
Λέκτρα δ᾽ ἀνδρῶν πόθῳ [and the beds of men with desire]
of those filling with their hands and with the staff that persuades mortals
such a mixing bowl of evils in the house this
